correction_2026_10_22.what_was_wrong: the record said font and text animation never reach the draft. They do. The check only looked at top-level text-material keys, while the writer puts the font inside the serialized `content` JSON as styles[].font, and the animation as a material_animations entry referenced from the segment.

measured_again.font=3D 만화 (name): same id written - name and id both resolve to the catalog entry
measured_again.animation_in name/id: material_animations has 1 entry and the segment extra_material_refs points at it

where_the_writer_does_it.font: src/draft.rs build_text_content() sets styles[].font from the resolved entry

correction_2026_10_22.lesson: verify a draft by parsing the material content and the reference lists, not by looking for a top-level key with the field name - the wire format nests both of them
